body: Hoist `const userHome = process.env.AGB_HOME_DIR || homedir();` above `const agyBin = ...` in `lib/agy.mjs` (line 251) so calling `runAgy()` with `bin` omitted and `process.env.AGB_AGY_BIN` unset does not throw a TDZ `ReferenceError`. Add a behavioral regression test in `test/agy.test.mjs` verifying `runAgy()` resolves `agy` via `resolveAgyBinary(userHome)` when both `bin` and `AGB_AGY_BIN` are omitted.
title: Fix runAgy TDZ ReferenceError on userHome in lib/agy.mjs
